messages:
taylor: quick question — can we add a region-mirroring mode for routes so we can warm failover caches without impacting primary latency? thinking 0.5–2% shadowed traffic to failover region + header to mark mirrored requests :thinking_face:
anya: sounds useful. main gotchas: cost, double quota counting, and making sure mirrored reqs never affect production state. we should mark them with `X-Redwood-Mirror: 1` and have gateway drop side-effects at the target.
mike: agree. also need header precedence rules. if a client sends `X-Region-Prefer` should mirror still go to the configured failover? i.e., precedence: client header -> route override -> system mirror?
taylor: precedence proposal: 1) explicit `X-Region-Force` from admin/console (highest), 2) client `X-Region-Prefer` for affinity, 3) routing policy (geo/latency), 4) mirror override should be orthogonal (mirror always duplicates based on routing policy but follows target region selection rules).
lee: careful: if `X-Region-Force` exists it should bypass mirror to avoid hitting a region we told clients to target for compliance. maybe mirror should respect force header.
sara: +1 to lee. Also need telemetry: metrics for mirrored vs normal token counts, p95 latency of mirror path, and separate error budgets. dashboard should show mirror warming efficiency (cache hit rate delta in failover region).
anya: UX question for console: make mirror a per-route toggle with sample rate slider and target-region selector. add warning if route has write semantics. default off for write routes.
mike: routing config example (rough):
```yaml
routes:
  - path: /v1/generate
    mirror:
      enabled: true
      sample_rate: 0.01
      target_region: us-west-2
      headers:
        add:
          X-Redwood-Mirror: "1"
        honor_force_header: false # if true, respects X-Region-Force and disables mirror
```
lee: we also need to think about match order. prefix matches vs exact path — mirror should attach after match resolution but before policy routing so the mirror target uses the same model variant selection logic.
devops-bot: deploy queued for gateway-config v3.14.2 by @taylor — staging tests required (mirror smoke test) :robot_face:
taylor: @devops-bot can we run a smoke which asserts mirrored requests have `X-Redwood-Mirror: 1` and that quota counters are incremented only on primary? want a unit that verifies quotas are not double-counted.
infra-bot: smoke run scheduled at 1845123300. result: pending.
sara: one more: fallback behavior when mirror target is down — should the mirror drop silently (best) or cascade a different failover region? prefer drop and log metric `mirror.drop_count` so we can monitor warming failures.
anya: agree. add `mirror.drop_on_error: true` default. logging: include `mirror_id` and `origin_ts` in trace for correlation.
mike: implementation tasks: gateway: honor mirror_WHITELIST for write routes, ensure policy evaluation order, add telemetry labels `mirror_target`, `mirror_sample_rate`.
taylor: thanks all — i'll sketch a RFC and wire up a console mock (sample-rate slider + region chooser + force header toggle). will link here shortly. :thumbsup:
